name: Tabasco
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's FODMAP-free, though spicy foods may irritate sensitive digestive systems during active SIBO.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts if you have a sensitive stomach
Mix into low-FODMAP dishes for flavor without adding FODMAPs
Store in refrigerator after opening for best quality
Check ingredient labels on flavored varieties for added garlic or onion
nutritionalHighlights: Contains capsaicin with potential anti-inflammatory properties
No significant vitamins or minerals due to small serving size
